columns.heading: Home languages
columns.intro: The fact sheet provides an overview of the importance of recognising, valuing and supporting children’s home languages. It highlights how home languages contribute to children’s identities, culture, wellbeing and learning, and how applying a culturally responsive lens can support quality observations, assessment and planning. The video includes examples of practice that recognises, considers and values home languages in kindergarten contexts.

columns.heading: Language and Literacy
columns.intro: The fact sheet provides an overview of the Language and Literacy learning domain, its sub domains of sounds and speech and comprehension, and its key elements. The video explores how these skills can be observed and supported in everyday kindergarten contexts.

columns.heading: Observational data and the planning cycle
columns.intro: This video explores how observe sits alongside assess, plan, implement and evaluate as the five key components of the Early Years Learning Framework planning cycle.

columns.heading: A collaborative approach to observation and assessment
columns.intro: This video explores how a collaborative approach to observation and assessment supports a more detailed and objective understanding of children’s learning, development and wellbeing.

columns.heading: A strengths-based approach to observation and assessment
columns.intro: This video explores how recording and analysing observations through a strengths-based lens involves careful consideration of language, tone, and the ways in which children’s capabilities are recognised and represented.

columns.heading: Observation and assessment through play
columns.intro: This video explores how teachers’ and educators’ approaches to observation and assessment are responsive to the way young children learn through play.

columns.heading: The purpose of observation
columns.intro: This video explores the intent to observe—to pause, notice, listen and think— as the starting point for recording quality observations and gaining deeper insights into children’s learning.

columns.heading: A deep dive: types of observation and assessment
columns.intro: This video explores the many ways to observe and document children’s learning.  It highlights how different types of observation provide different information about children’s learning, development and wellbeing.
